Extend also publishes an Agent Quickstart for equipping agents that run the CLI or write SDK code, and its doc pages are available as .md URLs that agents can consume directly. missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of agents using these docs effectively, and any evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or per-page agent guidance beyond the quickstart.
